bdt.feature.cs.configuration-locker.unlo: Makes ConfigurationLocker treat every config item as unlocked (isLocked returns false, getValueLocked returns null). Combined with 'Disable Apply All' this bypasses server config locking entirely.
bdt.feature.cs.configuration-locker.disa: Disables ConfigurationLocker.applyAll so locked values are no longer force-written to the active config. Only blocks replay; does not clear the 'modification forbidden' flag.
bdt.action.cs.configuration-locker.set-a: Calls ConfigurationLocker.setAuthorized to unlock the given paths, simulating server authorization. Accepts multiple paths at once.
bdt.action.cs.configuration-locker.set-l: Calls ConfigurationLocker.setLocked to lock and immediately replay path=value. Omitting the value means lock without a forced value.
bdt.action.cs.configuration-locker.enter: Calls ConfigurationLocker.enterServerLock to lock the default protected config (awaiting authorization). No arguments.
bdt.action.cs.configuration-locker.leave: Calls ConfigurationLocker.leaveServerLock to clear all lock entries and restore free config. No arguments.
